source_records.title: Andrews-Gordon Type Series for Kanade-Russell Conjectures
source_records.status: established source content; construction attribution, not independent full proof audit
source_records.inspection_depth: Section2 definitions/Gordon marking; Section3 Theorem7 statement, coordinate construction, forward/backward pair moves and context adjustments; not entire paper
source_records.relevant_result: Difference-side KR1 partitions map to base beta with n1 singles, n2 double clusters, exact-length zero-padded mu and eta divisible by3; weight n1^2+3n1n2+3n2^2+sum(mu)+sum(eta).
source_records.assumptions: Literal KR1 gap conditions; nonnegative cluster counts; fixed order of forward and backward moves; zeros retain coordinate length.
source_records.exact_correspondence: a=n1,b=n2,nu=eta/3 gives C weight. An isolated 2-cluster can change from distinct adjacent pair to repeated pair under one weight3 move.
source_records.mismatch: Does not provide B-to-C or RR005 F_U-to-F_C root map; marks are not an independently supplied U statistic.
source_records.next_falsifier: The isolated (1,2)->(3,3) move falsifies any assertion that 2-clusters coincide with repeated parts or preserve A-distinctness.
